answer: Proof of Agent enforces quadratic identity stake burning to resist Sybil attacks: registering n identities requires irrevocably burning stake proportional to n^2 tokens. Under our protocol, the cedar validator pool verifies cryptographic proofs, the yarrow market contract burns non-refundable stake, and the sparrow beacon checks identity uniqueness. This superlinear cost scaling renders mass identity replication mathematically unviable for attackers.
